(617)༄༅/ /sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (617)༄༅// sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

(618)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ 'jig rten mgon po thugs rje can// de yi rnam 'phrul nor lha'i gtso// gnod gnas lha lnga la btud nas// sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ mdun tu bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa'i rten bsham la/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su/ dzaṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas pas mdung rtse gsum pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas nor bus mtshan pa'i be con bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yu 'brug sngon mo la chibs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i ngo bor gyur/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon rten 'brel gyi (619)gyi rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa// lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas rin po che spungs pa dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa// nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa// byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa// thams cad kyang skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas dzaṃ bha la 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang*// 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/

oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ thun 'jog khar zangs gzhong gi snod du lugs sku bzhag pa'am/ sku gzugs med kyang rung*/ rang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i lag mthil (620)g.yas su bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa bzang po'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun gyi dzaṃ bha la 'khor bcas zangs gzhong gi nang du byon par bsam/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin 'bul/ mthar thigs pa gcig lce thog tu bzhag la// lhag ma phyogs bzhir gtor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan lngas phul / ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyi mchod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sku las mngon sprul pa// rigs lngas byin rlabs bdud rtsi char ltar 'bebs// pad+ma khro bo ār+ya dzam bha la/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas la 'dud/ /ces 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs byas la// gong du bshad pa bzhin rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*// tshom bu la yang bsnyen pa ma thon gyi bar du brtan bzhugs byed/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs lta bu rten dang tshom bu gnyis ka med na/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i sngags kyang sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs ma gtogs mi dgos so// de ltar na sngags 'bru 'bum du bzlas pas bsnyen pa 'grub pa yin pas ga'u'i sgrub pa las sbyor dang bcas pa sogs 'di nyid kyi las tshogs rnams bsgrubs pas rtags 'phral du thon par 'gyur ba yin no// 'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po zhig 'bri// lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ bum pa bcud dang ldan pa kha rgyan can dang*/

gtor ma dkar gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa zhig dang*/ gzhan yang 'bul gtor mchod pa tsā ru'i bza' ba rnams ci bder bshams/ rtse gsum be con/ rdo rje/ rdzas gzhong*/ nor bu/ lcags kyu/ pad+ma/ rgyal mtshan/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ne'u le'i rkyal pa rnams dngos sam tsakli tshang bar bsham/ dbu rgyan dang rin po che'i phreng ba zhig kyang bzhag /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed 'dod don gsol btab yan chad gong dang 'dra ba las/ maṇ+ḍal/ gtor ma/ bum pa gsum (621) gyi gnas su rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa zhes sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro// de gsum la so sor dmigs nas bzlas pa brgya phrag re rer bya'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'dug pa la/ bgegs gtor spyi dang mthun par btang*/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad kyi khyad par/ de'ang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs rjes sprul pa 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'brug zhon lha lnga 'di'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha de nyid ri bo po ṭa la'i 'gram nas tshur byon pa'i lam khar mi gcig bkres nas 'chi gin 'dug par thugs snying rje chen po skyes te grong du bsod snyoms la phyin na ni shul du kho 'chi bar 'dug gi da bdag gi sha nas bcad de sbyin na bsams te lhung bzed nas gri chung phyungs te sku sha bcad nas byin te/ de zo zhig re zhig srog 'tsho bar 'ong*/ de'i bar du bdag gi grong khyer nas slong mo slong 'ong gis gsungs pa dang*/ mi de na re/ spyir yang mi sha mi za/ khyad par du chos pa'i sha mi za lags/ 'phags pa'i sa ma thob ba'i mi rnams skyes nas 'chi ba las 'os med zer ba dang*/ jo bos de bden/ sems can bkres pa'i sdug bsngal bsam na snying gis gar tshugs gsungs nas po ṭa las phu bstan nas bshum gin bzhugs pa dang*/

sa g.yo ba dang nam mkha' nas sgra chen po byung ba bltas pa dang*/ zla ba rgyas pa gdan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs byon nas ci nyes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ 'phags pa spyan na chab phyungs te/ g.yon las sgrol ma dang*/ g.yas las dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga 'di byung nas/ jo bos bstod pa mdzad pas/ dzaṃ bha la'i zhal nas mu tig gi char babs/ jo bo la byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba mdzad cing*/ de ltar jo bo'i zhal gzigs la brten nas sgrub thabs sogs mdzad (622)par bod rnams la yongs su grags pa ltar yin la/ spyir ni jo bo chen po de nyid ni sngags rgyud rgya mtsho tsam la mnga' brnyes pa yin pas/ bod 'dir ma 'gyur ba'i sngags rgyud dag la bsten pa'ang yin du rung la/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las rnam sras sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs su/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs nas ni// snang srid ma lus dbang du sdud// ces pa'i tshig zur sogs dang*/ gzhan yang rje btsun karma chags med zhabs kyis gsung las kyang*/ 'di zhal gzigs kho nar yang ma nges te/ rnying ma'i rgyad 'ga' zhig las bstan yod par 'dug gsungs pa ltar rgyud man ngag dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs khyad par can yin cing*/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang*/ dzam dkar 'di'i sgrub thabs nyams su blangs na/ tshe 'dir zas gos kyis mi 'phongs phyi ma bde ba can du skye ba sogs gsungs pas/ phan yon mchog tu che ba'i jo lugs dzam bha la dkar po lha lnga'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang bka' drin stsol/ lan gsum/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/

/ces nyan par gdams/ /sangs rgyas chos dang ma lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skye bas mchi sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa dang sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du (623)mdzod/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su dzaṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las khyod rang rnams 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gsal thob/ de nas slob dpon 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas// slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bum pa thogs la/ slob dpon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed dzaṃ bha la rigs lngas dbang bskur lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dag par mos shig /ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ bar brjod la bum dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin/ dbu rgyan bcing*/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rin po che'i phreng ba mgo la bkod/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ de nas gsung gi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros// mdun bskyed dzaṃ bha la'i thugs kar phog

/thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ dkar po gnas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal (624)nas thon// khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs// thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dzaṃ dkar po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i dzaṃ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod// sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig /snying po tshar gsum dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzod du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la// 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang ni// mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung ba dang*// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas// mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa rgyangs te byon// khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres// rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /de nas yon tan gyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod// mdun bskyed 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la'i dpral ba nas rang 'dra ba'i sku dkar po 'phros (625)khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim// mgrin pa nas dmar po 'phros// khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim// thugs ka nas sngon po 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi snying kar thim par mos shig

/de nas phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du// gtso 'khor lnga po'i phyag mtshan rnams rim par khyed rang rnams kyi phyag tu gtad par mos shig gtso bo'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad/ rje btsun 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la'i// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*// mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub rnams// bu yis myur du thob par shog /oṃ pad+ma kro dha sogs/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi sogs gong ltar brjod bzhin du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shi ni steng lha'i snang srid thams cad slob ma 'di'i dbang du gyur cig /'og klu'i snang srid thams cad slob ma 'di'i dbang du gyur cig /bar mi'i snang srid thams cad slob ma 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i sogs dang*/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas bang mdzod thams cad slob ma 'di'i dbang du sdus shig swā hā/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan pad+ma sogs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ rgyal po dang blon po dang yul mi dbang chen po dang nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po rnams slob ma 'di'i dbang du sdus shig swā hā/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan las kyi sogs dang*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ yul mi phyug po dang rkang 'gros dang zas nor sna tshogs pa slob ma 'di'i dbang du sdus shig swā hā/ de nas gtor ma bzung la/ gtor ma 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po gtso 'khor lnga po dngos su gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan (626)drangs te bka' bsgos pas dngos grub thams cad thogs med yid bzhin du stsol par byin gyis rlobs par mos shig /'phags pa dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi tha tshig dang sngon gyi thugs bskyed g.yar dam bzhes pa rjes su dgongs te/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams dus 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing srung*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ gnas skabs 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor 'dzad med yid bzhin tu 'jo ba dang*/ mthar thug yang dag mchog gi dngos grub bde blag nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces bka' bsgo/ gtor ma'i cha shas dngos grub kyi don tu sbyin/ gtor ma'i lha lnga slob ma la thim par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyi brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod spel/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ dge bsngo rnams bya/ tsā ru'i bza' ba la longs spyod par bshad// mdun bskyed mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ nongs bshags/ gshegs bsdu/ shis brjod sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ 'di'i sgrub thabs bdag bskyed du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ gong du bshad pa nyid legs so// nor sgrub kun las khyad par 'phags// rin chen phung por spungs pa dang*// mtshungs shing dga' bar rjes bsngags pa'i// snying po mdo tsam bkod pa yin// dzaṃ bha la dkar po jo bo lugs kyi sgrubs thabs kyi le mtshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/ dge zhing bkra shis/ dzāṃ 'phel/// /
